notes: The selected analysis panel is one selection for one study design. General availability per TCGA project is reported separately and is larger; do not mix the two.
Spatial studies come from patients other than those in TCGA. They add tissue context, not measurements for TCGA patients.

Spatial resources are shown at two image levels. "Original H&E located": the original scan, measured expression and coordinates were found. "Matched data with preview image": expression and coordinates match a released preview image, and the original scan was not located; such data support molecular spatial maps, not whole-slide or tile models, cell morphology, physical distances or registration sign-off. Registration, calibration and tissue QC may be pending at either level.

Spatial section records are per study, not globally unique physical sections or independent assays. Patients are study-local IDs given by the source; sections without one add no patients, and no eligible-patient total is established.
Counts reported by a study keep that study's own unit (sections, slides, samples, donors) and are never added across studies. An unknown count is absent, not zero.
located_sections lists selection fields only; the full record with links, source wording and clinical fields is in data/captures.json under the same id.

evidence.citation: Hausser J, Szekely P, Bar N, Zimmer A, Sheftel H, Caldas C, Alon U. Tumor diversity and the trade-off between universal cancer tasks. Nature Communications 10, 5423 (2019).
evidence.scale: Bulk tumour RNA (TCGA; METABRIC for breast)
evidence.definition: Archetypes are vertices of a polytope fitted to tumour expression (Pareto task inference); each vertex is interpreted as a profile specialised for a task.
evidence.finding: Of 15 cancer types with at least 250 primary tumours, six showed significant within-type structure under the authors' strong criterion (LGG, THCA, BRCA, BLCA, LIHC, COAD) and lung adenocarcinoma and head and neck carcinoma were borderline. The other seven (CESC, KIRC, LUSC, OV, PRAD, STAD, UCEC) had no detectable vertices in the RNA representation tested. After removing cancer-type means, 3,180 tumours from the six significant types fitted five archetypes, interpreted as cell division, biomass and energy, lipogenesis, immune interaction and invasion/tissue remodelling.
evidence.limits: Task labels are interpretations of enrichment near each vertex. The five-task result depends on the six selected cancers and on centring within cancer type; it does not establish five tasks in every cancer or in morphology. A negative geometry test in one RNA representation does not show that archetypes are absent. Cancer types outside the screen, including ESCA, PAAD and READ, were not tested.
